explanation: I found no match in Mathlib. The theorem says that the depth of `QuotSMulTop x M` over `R ⧸ (x)`, plus 1, equals the depth of `M` over `R`, when `x` is a regular element in the maximal ideal. Its proof applies `Module.depth_quotient_quotSMulTop_succ_eq`, but that lemma is the library's own: it is defined in `P2M/Sol/S_Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.lean`, not in Mathlib. This Mathlib version has no `Module.depth` at all. Grepping its `Mathlib` directory for `Module.depth` and `def depth` found only an unrelated `depth` in `Data/W/Basic.lean` (W-types). It also has no `depth_quotient_quotSMulTop_succ_eq`. So Mathlib cannot contain this depth result.
